Class SshClientApp.SshSeat

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientApp.SshSeat
Enclosing class:
SshClientApp
private static final class SshClientApp.SshSeat extends Object
The SshSeat is the text snapshot a count runs on. The strings are copied before the worker counts them. A null memory is stored as an empty string. A null draft is stored as an empty string.

    • SshSeat

      private SshSeat(long sequence, TerminalSession session, boolean held, int base, String memory, String draft)
      The constructor stores one snapshot. A null memory becomes an empty string. A null draft becomes an empty string.
      Parameters:
      sequence - The edit number.
      session - The pane the text came from.
      held - True when a Roux tally is the base.
      base - The held integer.
      memory - The session text.
      draft - The unsent line.
